name: excel-vba-mcp
description: A bundled read-only MCP server for the Excel VBA MCP project.

interface.shortDescription: Connect Codex to the Excel VBA MCP server.
interface.longDescription: Phase 1 bundles a read-only MCP server with ping and get_version tools. Excel, COM, VBIDE, workbook, and VBA capabilities remain deferred.
interface.defaultPrompt: Check whether the Excel VBA MCP server is available and report its version.
